caption: The drawing depicts a cream-colored ceramic pitcher with a wide mouth, a slightly flared spout, and a round base. The pitcher’s exterior is decorated with a painted floral design featuring a large pink flower with elongated petals, accompanied by green leaves and two blue flowers on either side. The pitcher shows visible signs of wear, including cracks, chips, and a missing section near the rim and on the side, revealing a rough, brownish texture underneath. The background is plain and beige, with no other objects or designs present. Near the pitcher, there is a faint label that reads “No. 13 NOLLICHUCKUK MOUNDS”.
title: Crockery Pitcher
